get.description: What the matching step reads. Same row as `getJob`, with the JD prose.

post.description: Resolves the FR-7.3 keyword interrupt. There is no bulk variant on purpose.

get.description:
The stored .tex compiled, not re-rendered: the PDF has to be the document the
user is looking at, including anything the model rectified since the last render.

The same render as `/render`, handed over as the .tex itself. `/render` returns
it inside JSON, where every newline is an escape the caller has to undo before
the source is usable.

post.description:
The layout is read from the .tex itself, so the upload is the file and
little else. A `%%! skills=grid location=city` line in the .tex overrides it.

get.description: Read by the extension's background worker for screening questions.
One aggregation: the account, the personal details, and the four lists.

AccountUpdate.title: AccountUpdate
AccountUpdate.description:
What the profile page may change. Email and password are deliberately absent:
one is the login key and the other needs hashing, so both need their own flow.

Actor.title: Actor
Actor.description: Who caused it. The audit trail behind every guardrail claim.

Address.title: Address
Address.description:
ATS forms want the parts separately; `profile.location` is one free-text
line, which is right for a resume header and useless for a form.

ApplicantFields.title: ApplicantFields
ApplicantFields.description:
The facts every application form asks for and no resume carries, so the
profile has nowhere to put them. Stored once, answered everywhere.

This is not `P4-02`: those are discovery preferences (which jobs to look for).
These are answers about you, used only when filling a form.

ApplicationFill.title: ApplicationFill
ApplicationFill.description: The extension reporting what it filled. Reporting only — it submits nothing.

ApplicationStage.title: ApplicationStage
ApplicationStage.description: What `resume` posts once a .tex exists for the job.

ApplicationStatus.title: ApplicationStatus
ApplicationStatus.description: STAGED is pre-submit. Everything after it is a human's doing.

BaseResumeStore.title: BaseResumeStore
BaseResumeStore.description: What the Resume screen submits once the user accepts the render.

Company.title: Company
Company.description: Denormalized onto the job — the company rail on the job page reads only this.

Demographics.title: Demographics
Demographics.description:
US-style EEO questions. Every field is free text and every one is optional —
"Prefer not to say" is a real answer and the default is to answer nothing.

EventAppend.title: EventAppend
EventAppend.description: Append-only: there is no update or delete on an event.

FieldFill.title: FieldFill
FieldFill.description: What the extension put in one field. FR-5.4 — an unmarked fill is a silent edit.

JobCreate.title: JobCreate
JobCreate.description: The posting as discovery found it.

JobStatus.title: JobStatus
JobStatus.description: Pipeline column on the dashboard board.

JobUpdate.title: JobUpdate
JobUpdate.description: Every field optional: a PATCH sends only what changed.

KeywordSelection.title: KeywordSelection
KeywordSelection.description: The user's answer at the interrupt. An empty list is a valid answer.

LineChange.title: LineChange
LineChange.description:
One tailored line of the .tex, kept with what it replaced so the diff
screen and the source screen can never disagree.

MatchWrite.title: MatchWrite
MatchWrite.description: What the matching agent posts. The JD vector goes to Atlas, never here.

PresentKeyword.title: PresentKeyword
PresentKeyword.description: Already in the resume. Read-only on the selection screen.

ProfileUpdate.title: ProfileUpdate
ProfileUpdate.description:
A PATCH body: only the fields the caller sent are touched. Distinguishing
"absent" from "null" is the point — an explicit null clears the field, which
`exclude_unset` preserves and `exclude_none` would swallow.

`links` is all-or-nothing: half a list means nothing, so sending it replaces it.

ResumeStore.title: ResumeStore
ResumeStore.description: What the tailoring agent posts once it has written the file.

RiskFlag.title: RiskFlag
RiskFlag.description: FR-2.4 — surfaced, never selectable. Acting on one would be a misrepresentation.

SignUp.title: SignUp
SignUp.description:
Three fields and no more. Role and picture are set later from My Details,
through `AccountUpdate` — asking for them at signup only adds a field nobody
fills in.

SkillFields.title: SkillFields
SkillFields.description: One group and its items — `Languages: Python, Go`.

TemplateStyle.title: TemplateStyle
TemplateStyle.description:
How this design lays out the blocks that differ between templates.

All of it except `location` is read off the uploaded .tex — see
`service.infer_style`. A `%%!` directive line in the .tex overrides any of it.

TemplateUpdate.title: TemplateUpdate
TemplateUpdate.description: Every field optional: a PATCH sends only what changed.
